summary: Comprehensive architecture and implementation plan to improve the complete Blog Posts, Edit Blog Post, and Create New Blog Post pages in the Tiqsey Admin Panel. Introduces a high-density catalog table with segmented status tabs, multi-select bulk actions, interactive inline status switches, and 1-click copyable post IDs. In the post editor, introduces an interactive side-by-side split view with real-time live preview, storefront links, and refined typographic styling.
